newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Eagle USA Airfreight.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eagle USA Airfreight.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said it initiated coverage of Eagle USA Airfreight Inc as a buy.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Alex. Brown later said it set a six-to-12 month price target of $34 a share.
-- said Eagle USA could achieve earnings growth of about 25 percent or greater over the next three to five years.

-- said expects Eagle to post strong growth through its domestic airfreight forwarding network. The company is also expected to expand its services internationally and grow its domestic pick-up and delivery business.
